$comment: Scope of the weekly external attack-surface scan (easm-scan.yml, issue #184, SecOps plan Step 31). Scan only what we own or operate. Every domain and range needs an owner and an authorisation: 'owned' for Sparkgeo's own registrations, otherwise a reference to the client's written authorisation (ticket or document), without which the entry is refused by check-scope. known_hosts lists internet-facing hosts the asset register cannot name (the register lists cloud resources, not DNS names it did not create). exclude lists hosts that must never be probed. See docs/easm.md.
